WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO "ASiruk".reminders (session_id, or_id, due_at)
  SELECT s.id, s.or_id,
         (SELECT max(d) FROM (
            SELECT d FROM generate_series(
                     s.finished_at + interval '1 day',
                     s.finished_at + interval '30 days',
                     interval '1 day') AS d
            WHERE extract(isodow FROM d) < 6
            LIMIT 10
          ) x)
  FROM "ASiruk".interview_sessions s
  WHERE s.status IN ('completed', 'evaluated')
    AND s.is_training = false
    AND s.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND s.or_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS создано;

SELECT r.id AS reminder_id,
       r.session_id,
       r.due_at,
       u_or.full_name  AS or_name,
       u_or.email      AS or_email,
       u_emp.full_name AS employee_name,
       s.finished_at,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM "ASiruk".interview_sessions s2
         WHERE s2.employee_id = s.employee_id
           AND s2.created_at > s.finished_at
           AND s2.is_training = false) AS новых_сессий
FROM "ASiruk".reminders r
JOIN "ASiruk".interview_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id
LEFT JOIN "ASiruk".users u_or  ON u_or.id  = r.or_id
LEFT JOIN "ASiruk".users u_emp ON u_emp.id = s.employee_id
WHERE r.sent_at IS NULL
  AND r.due_at <= now()
ORDER BY r.due_at;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE "ASiruk".reminders
  SET sent_at = now()
  WHERE id IN ({{ $json.ids_sql }})
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM upd) AS отмечено,
       {{ $json.to_send }} AS к_отправке,
       {{ $json.skipped }} AS пропущено;
